label: Claude Code Desktop (parallel sessions)
description: The Claude Code desktop app: a sessions sidebar with SEVERAL parallel sessions (status dots + badges: working / needs input / done) beside a live session pane with the full Claude Code performance (prompts, tool calls, diffs, working spinner with live counters, streaming responses). THE FLEET STORY: agents running in parallel while you steer one -- use switch-session and session-status to play it out. SCRIPTED performable surface; camera anchors: sessions, transcript, input.

sessions.label: Sidebar sessions: [{project: 'acme-api', title: 'Fix flaky auth tests', status: 'working'|'input'|'done'|'idle'}]. Defaults to a believable 3-session fleet.

history.label: Transcript blocks for the active pane at open: [{type: 'user'|'text'|'tool', ...}]

model_label.label: Right side of the hint row

script.label: The full performance: all claude-code-session actions (type-prompt, send-prompt, working, tool-call, respond, claude-text, stop-working) PLUS fleet actions: switch-session {index, history?, clear?} (sidebar highlight moves, the pane swaps to that session's transcript), session-status {index, status: 'working'|'input'|'done'} (a sidebar session's dot + badge change -- e.g. a parallel agent finishes while you watch another). NEVER move the camera from a script -- scene camera_moves with anchors (sessions, transcript, input).

script_actions.description: Post the typed prompt to the transcript

⏺ tool block with ⎿ result and optional green/red diff
Stream Claude's response word by word
Move the sidebar highlight to another session and swap the pane to its transcript
